mapper.select: SELECT file_id, post_id, original_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size FROM post_file WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_file (post_id, original_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size) VALUES (#{postId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
